method: Typed text-evidence and artifact-byte SHA-256 comparison between the committed M12-002 reports and this revision, followed by the hardened verifier suites. No capture, measurement or verification command produced new evidence: the selected archive, the second supported SDK, the retained binary/source capture roots and the native guest are unavailable in this clone. The task is BLOCKED because a required acceptance input is absent.

rejected_commands.python3 tools/m12_002_deployment.py veri: Exit 1. The command now also requires WIRESTACK_SOURCE_CAPTURE_ROOT, WIRESTACK_BINARY_WRAPPER, WIRESTACK_BINARY_OPENSSL_LIBRARY and WIRESTACK_BINARY_OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY; with every selector present it stops at the committed verification.json, whose source inventory predates this revision (ValueError: task source inventory is incomplete). Behind that refusal the selected archive docs/evidence/M12-001/native-final/wirestack-baseline.tar.gz is not tracked and is absent, so no deployment snapshot can be regenerated or verified.
rejected_commands.python3 tools/m12_002_deployment.py cont: Exit 1 without either SDK selection: it raises 'WIRESTACK_STABLE_SDK_ROOT must select the exact SDK to verify'. With both selections pointing at the installed sts 1.1.3 tree it exits 0 with 'Ran 146 tests ... OK', which exercises the contract suite only; it is not a second-version claim and it does not accept the stale reports.
rejected_commands.scripts/check-m7-032-public-api --json: Exit 1 with {"status": "FAIL", "error": "committed public API inventory is stale"}; the current public API inventory is M7-032's to refresh, not this task's.

required_before_completion: Obtain the selected development archive that the source, binary and deployment verifiers bind.
Recapture stable-native with the installed sts1.1.3 and candidate-native with a second explicitly supported STS identity.
Re-execute the native platform profile in a KVM guest with the selected glibc 2.44 runtime and confirm the transferred consumer sources before rebuild.
Regenerate docs/evidence/M12-002/verification.json with tools/m12_002_deployment.py collect --binary-report <verified report> after the final source edits.
Rerun scripts/check-task M12-002 --json and only then claim COMPLETE.

not_run.reason: The selected archive and the second supported SDK identity are absent; only sts1.1.3 is installed and authorized.
No KVM guest image, glibc 2.44 runtime or provenance is retained in this checkout.
Depends on the three inputs above; see docs/evidence/M12-002/review-remediation/report.json.

required_retained_inputs.WIRESTACK_SOURCE_CAPTURE_ROOT: private source-capture root holding <profile>/ TLS fixtures; the source verifier re-hashes the seven fixture files there, and private keys are never committed
required_retained_inputs.WIRESTACK_BINARY_CAPTURE_ROOT: retained binary capture directory holding raw disassembly output and installed consumers
required_retained_inputs.WIRESTACK_BINARY_WRAPPER: exact SDK environment wrapper file used by the capture
required_retained_inputs.WIRESTACK_BINARY_OPENSSL_LIBRARY: exact independent OpenSSL SSL library file
required_retained_inputs.WIRESTACK_BINARY_OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY: exact independent OpenSSL crypto library file
required_retained_inputs.note: Every selector is required and has no default. The two TLS libraries must be distinct files and must match the binary report's external_tls_fixture digests.

changes: tools/m12_002_deployment.py passes the selected wrapper, capture root and both TLS libraries into m12_002_binary.verify, which previously received five arguments for a nine-parameter signature
collect() validates the complete snapshot in memory and publishes it atomically, so a refused verification leaves no COMPLETE snapshot
verify_scan_verdicts() re-derives ISA counts from the retained complete raw disassembly bound by disassembly_raw and the truncation marker, failing closed when unavailable
verify_tls_fixtures() re-hashes the seven retained fixture files under WIRESTACK_SOURCE_CAPTURE_ROOT/<profile> instead of comparing each digest with itself
